item.name: PayU – S2S Authorise Flow (doTransaction RESERVE)
item.description: Server-to-server RESERVE via doTransaction. CREDITCARD only. Requires metadata.payuAuthorizeFlow=DO_TRANSACTION plus card/customer fields (cardNumber, cardExpiry, cvv, nameOnCard, firstName, lastName, mobile, email). Set metadata.secure3d=true to request 3DS. Current PayU staging may still return immediate AUTHORIZED even when 3DS is requested; if PayU invokes 3DS, expect PENDING_3DS or PENDING with a redirectUrl.

exec: pm.test('status is AUTHORIZED or FAILED', function () { pm.expect(['AUTHORIZED', 'FAILED']).to.include(json.status); });
pm.test('no redirectUrl on baseline flow', function () { pm.expect(json.redirectUrl).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test('status is AUTHORIZED or FAILED', function () { pm.expect(['AUTHORIZED', 'FAILED']).to.include(json.status); });
pm.test('no redirectUrl on void baseline flow', function () { pm.expect(json.redirectUrl).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test('status is AUTHORIZED, PENDING, PENDING_3DS, or FAILED', function () { pm.expect(['AUTHORIZED', 'PENDING', 'PENDING_3DS', 'FAILED']).to.include(json.status); });
pm.test('pending 3DS has redirectUrl', function () { pm.expect(json.redirectUrl || json.checkoutUrl).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('pending 3DS inlineRedirect matches redirect url', function () { pm.expect(json.inlineRedirect.url).to.eql(json.redirectUrl || json.checkoutUrl); });

item.name: PayU – Operations
item.description: Post-payment PayU S2S doTransaction operations. Replay the verified live sequence in this order: 1) create an AUTHORIZED RESERVE with the S2S /authorise CREDITCARD doTransaction request, 2) run S2S FINALIZE on that payment, 3) run S2S CREDIT on the finalized payment, 4) create a second AUTHORIZED RESERVE, 5) run S2S RESERVE_CANCEL on the second payment. These requests reflect the successful live sequence validated against PayU staging.

item.name: GET /payments/:id/provider-status (getTransaction lookup)
item.description: Uses PayU getTransaction with the documented sample payload shape: AdditionalInformation contains only payUReference. Verified live against staging after removing merchantReference from the lookup request.

exec: pm.test('lookup did not hit known wiring error 301', function () { pm.expect(json.resultCode).to.not.eql('301'); });

item.name: POST /payments/:id/capture (S2S FINALIZE)
item.description: PayU S2S doTransaction FINALIZE. Use this on an AUTHORIZED RESERVE payment created via the S2S /authorise request. Expected live outcome: CAPTURED.

item.name: POST /payments/:id/refund (S2S CREDIT)
item.description: PayU S2S doTransaction CREDIT. Use this only after S2S FINALIZE has succeeded on the same payment. Expected live outcome: REFUNDED.

item.name: POST /payments/:id/void (S2S RESERVE_CANCEL)
item.description: PayU S2S doTransaction RESERVE_CANCEL. Use this on an AUTHORIZED RESERVE that has not been finalized. Expected live outcome: VOIDED.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: PayU IPN callbacks. ResponseHash in IpnExtraInfo is used for deduplication. Run a payment request first so paymentId and providerReference are populated.
